jobs.title: Director, Systems & Platform Integration, FCC
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
===================

**You will be working on a 100% remote schedule as part of Fidelity’s dynamic working arrangement.**

 **Current work authorization for Canada is required for all openings.**

  

At Fidelity, we’ve been helping Canadian investors build better financial futures for over 35 years. We offer individuals and institutions a range of trusted investment portfolios and services \- and we’re constantly seeking to find new and better ways to help our clients. As a privately owned company, we boldly embrace innovation in all areas as we continue to grow our business into the future.

  

Working with us means you’ll be part of a diverse and dedicated group of people who make a real difference for our clients and communities every day. You’ll have a wide range of opportunities to grow and develop your career in an inclusive environment where you’ll feel valued and supported to be your best \- both personally and professionally.

 **How You’ll Make an Impact**


The Director, Systems \& Platform Integration will lead FCC’s capability for connecting the systems, platforms, vendors, services, and data flows that support Fidelity Clearing Canada’s business. FCC operates in a regulated clearing and brokerage environment serving introducing brokers, portfolio managers, and institutional/intermediary clients. This role owns the integration layer across FCC’s APIs, services, messages, files, data interfaces, vendor/client platform connections, workflows, reporting, operations, and enterprise services, while aligning with Fidelity Canada, FIL, and broader enterprise standards where relevant.

* Integrate clients, platforms, vendors, enterprise services, APIs, messages, files, and data feeds securely and reliably.
* Keep FCC’s clearing, brokerage, client, reporting, reconciliation, and operational flows auditable, monitored, recoverable, and ready for growth.
* Move FCC toward reusable integration standards, stronger automation, AI enablement, operational digitization, scalable platform capabilities, and alignment with Fidelity Canada, FIL, and FCC\-specific needs.
* Provide senior client\-facing leadership for organizations integrating with FCC, building trusted relationships with client technology and business representatives and ensuring that integration requirements, solution options, responsibilities, risks, timelines, testing, cutover readiness, and support expectations are clearly understood and effectively managed.
* Own a roadmap balancing modernization, workflow automation, AI enablement, operational digitization, enterprise integration, resiliency, risk reduction, cost, and delivery trade\-offs.
* All direct reports have clear performance expectations, regular coaching, development plans, and succession or cross\-training coverage for critical capabilities.

 **What We’re Looking For**

* University degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, Business Technology or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* 7\+ years of technology management and leadership experience in financial services, clearing, brokerage, wealth, custody, banking, capital markets, or another regulated transaction\-processing environment.
* Strong experience leading systems/platform integration, APIs, services, messaging, files, batch, data feeds, vendor connectivity, client\-facing platform delivery, and modern integration platforms such as Solace, Boomi, Kafka, MuleSoft, IBM MQ/App Connect, AWS/Azure Integration Services, or similar tools.
* Demonstrated technical leadership in integration architecture, solution design, design reviews, non\-functional requirements, production readiness, and technical risk decisions.
* Demonstrated experience in a client\-facing leadership role, working directly with external clients and senior stakeholders
* Experience leading teams of architects, analysts, technical leads, integration specialists, etc.,

 **The Skill Set You Bring**

* Experience using AI\-assisted development, automation, analytics insight, developer productivity tooling, and enterprise integration capabilities is an asset
* Experience governing integration standards for service contracts, data mappings, API design, event flows, file exchanges, error handling, monitoring, logging, auditability, and support handoff.
* Strong understanding of Agile, DevOps, CI/CD, cloud\-enabled architecture, production reliability, observability, incident/problem/change
* Technically credible and engineering\-first \- understands APIs, services, messages, files, event streaming, iPaaS, ESB, data flows, system dependencies, production support, architecture, standards, integration tools such as Solace, Boomi, Kafka, MuleSoft or similar platforms, automation, developer productivity, and technical risk.
* Understands clearing, brokerage, reporting, reconciliation, regulatory, service quality, and operational impacts.
* Architecturally minded, modernization oriented, and operationally disciplined \- drives reusable standards, scalable integration capability, monitoring, controls, recoverability, cybersecurity, auditability, resilience, and production stability.
* Strong client\-facing, relationship\-management, presentation, and communication skills, with the credibility to lead technical discussions, explain trade\-offs, resolve issues, and build confidence with clients, partners, and senior executives.
* Enterprise\-aligned portfolio integrator \- connects FCC priorities with Fidelity Canada, FIL, enterprise technology direction, modernization, AI enablement, operational digitization, and BAU stability.

 **Some of the ways we’ll help you feel valued and supported as part of our team:**

* Flexible working arrangements that vary based on role requirements
* Competitive total compensation, including company contributions to your group RRSP without a matching requirement from you
* Comprehensive health benefits that start on your first day, with 100% employer\

jobs.description:
Questrade Financial Group (QFG), through its companies \- Questrade, Questbank, Questrade Wealth Management, Community Trust Company, Zolo, and Flexiti, provides securities and foreign currency investment, professionally managed investment portfolios, mortgages, real estate services, financial services and more. We use cutting\-edge technology to help Canadians become much more financially successful and secure.
  
At QFG, we combine human\-centric collaboration with AI\-driven innovation to redefine financial services. The ideal candidate will be a catalyst for change, using AI to transform and deliver unparalleled customer experiences and shaping a future where AI empowers our teams to do their best work.
  
Join our diverse, inclusive, and hybrid workplace to unleash your creativity and nurture your curiosity without limits. If you share this sense of infinite possibility, come shape your future at QFG.
  
  

What’s in it for you as an employee of QFG?
  
* Health \& wellbeing resources and programs
* Paid vacation, personal, and sick days for work\-life balance
* Competitive compensation and benefits packages
* Work\-life balance in a hybrid environment with at least 3 days in office
* Career growth and development opportunities
* Opportunities to contribute to community causes
* Work with diverse team members in an inclusive and collaborative environment


This job posting is for an existing vacancy
  
  

We’re looking for our next Director, FP\&A. Could It Be You?
  
The Director, Financial Planning \& Analysis (FP\&A) is a key leadership role within the Finance team, designed to deliver insightful financial information and strategic analysis to the Executive Team and Board of Directors. Contributing directly to the success of Questbank and Questrade Financial Group, this role leads the business case and investment process, budget and forecast functions, and comprehensive management reporting. The Director plays a pivotal role in tracking headcount investments and overall financial performance while leading precise, fact\-based upfront analysis for upwards of $100MM in new yearly initiatives, ensuring alignment with both short\- and long\-term corporate strategic objectives.
  
  

Need more details? Keep reading…
  
**In this role, responsibilities include but are not limited to:**
  
* Leading the development, monitoring, and reporting for all business cases within the organization. Oversee precise and fact\-based upfront analysis, ongoing monitoring, and reporting to the executive team for upwards of $100MM in new initiatives annually to ensure success.
* Directing and driving the preparation and consolidation of the annual budget and monthly rolling forecasts. Collaborate closely with division leaders to ensure all assumptions are tested and vetted properly, ownership exists at the division level, and consensus is gained to align on organizational goals.
* Leading the comprehensive monthly review of consolidated financials against the budget. Provide in\-depth analysis to division leaders and the executive team focusing on KPIs, key ratios, and delivering value\-added commentary on next steps to keep the company on track for its long\-term strategic goals.
* Driving rigorous financial modeling for all acquisitions and special projects. Work closely with corporate development to ensure detailed and accurate models covering organic growth, acquisition\-related growth, integration economics, income statements, balance sheets, cash flows, and covenants, enabling Senior Management to make informed decisions.
* Being responsible for all management reporting to division leads, the executive team, and the board (including Management Reports, Journey Reports, business KPIs, key ratios, corporate scorecards, and MD\&A) against the budget, forecast, prior year, prior month, and the 5\-year plan. Ensure consistency across corporate and business unit reporting.
* Serving as the primary FP\&A system lead, driving continuous improvement and automation in financial processes, reporting frameworks, and data integrity.
* Partnering with senior leadership, Treasury, and Risk Management to ensure financial reporting consistency, liquidity tracking, and holistic strategic decision\-making support.
* Structuring, managing, and mentoring the FP\&A team to align with corporate requirements. Set clear performance objectives, provide regular feedback, and foster a high\-performance culture.


So are YOU our next Director, FP\&A? You are if you…
  
* Have a Post\-secondary degree/diploma in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field.
* Have a completed CPA or equivalent accounting designation
* Have 10\+ years of experience in the financial industry
* Have 5\+ years of experience in a similar FP\&A role
* Have 5\+ years in a management role
* Have advanced financial modeling, budgeting and analytical skills.


Additional kudos if you…
  
* Have experience in financial services, wealth management, or banking (highly beneficial for Questbank).
* Have experience with enterprise FP\&A and ERP systems such as NetSuite or Oracle EPBCS (Hyperion)

**Synopsis of the Role**

  

Reporting to the Chief Operations Officer (COO), the Head of Enterprise Project Management Office (EPMO) and Organizational Change Management Practice (OCM) provides enterprise\-wide leadership and strategic oversight of Equifax Canada’s project and program portfolio, ensuring alignment with business priorities and strategic objectives.

  

  

This role partners closely with local and global leaders across Product, Technology, and Operations to drive execution excellence, strengthen portfolio governance, and accelerate business outcomes through effective project delivery and organizational change.

  

  

**What you'll do**

  

**Strategic Leadership, Governance \& Portfolio Management**

  

* **Enterprise Methodologies \& Frameworks** : Develop and implement enterprise\-wide project management methodologies aligned with industry best practices (e.g., PMBOK, Agile, Lean), alongside robust Organizational Change Management (OCM) frameworks, tools, and standardized templates.
* **Portfolio Governance \& Intake** : Establish and manage a standardized project intake, business case evaluation, prioritization, and portfolio management framework aligned with strategic business outcomes.
* **Executive Reporting \& Metrics** : Develop, track, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs), scorecards, financial forecasts, and status summaries for senior leadership, steering committees, and C\-Suite.
  

  

* **Continuous Improvement** : Evaluate the ongoing effectiveness of current projects and change plans, driving continuous process enhancements and organizational learning

* **Execution \& Quality Oversight:** Oversee projects execution, ensuring projects adhere to timelines, quality standards, budget limits, and formal scope change controls.
  

  

* **Risk Mitigation \& Issue Resolution** : Conduct risk assessments, implement mitigation plans, and provide direct guidance to project managers to remove operational roadblocks.
  

  

* **Kickoffs \& Retrospectives** : Lead project kickoffs and retrospectives to capture learnings and optimize future project execution.

* **OCM Capability Building** : Own the design, development, and delivery of enterprise OCM education programs, toolkits, and knowledge transfer across internal teams and external partners
  

  

**Team Leadership \& Development**  



* **Team Building \& Mentorship** : Build, inspire, and lead high\-performing EPMO and OCM teams, fostering a collaborative, team\-based environment.
  

  

* **Coaching \& Performance Management** : Establish clear performance expectations, conduct execution assessments, provide continuous feedback, and deliver professional development opportunities.

.

jobs.title: Finance Director
jobs.description:
**Company:** Rwandan Canadian Healing Centre (RCHC)

**Location:** Toronto, Ontario

**Job Type:** Part\-time

**Schedule:** Approximately 4 hours per week

**Work Arrangement:** To be confirmed

**Reports To:** Executive Director

About the Rwandan Canadian Healing Centre

The Rwandan Canadian Healing Centre (RCHC) is a nonprofit organization dedicated to supporting newcomers and refugees through transitional housing, employment assistance, community programs, and initiatives that promote stability, inclusion, and independence.

Our organization is committed to responsible financial management, transparency, and accountability to ensure that our resources effectively support the individuals and communities we serve.

Position Overview

RCHC is seeking an experienced, detail\-oriented, and highly organized **Finance Director** to oversee the organization's financial operations, bookkeeping, financial reporting, budgeting, payroll, and regulatory compliance.

The successful candidate will play an important role in maintaining accurate financial records, strengthening internal controls, improving financial processes, and supporting informed organizational decision\-making.

Working closely with the Executive Director, Board of Directors, Program Manager, and other team members, the Finance Director will help ensure responsible stewardship of organizational resources and the long\-term financial sustainability of RCHC.

This position is ideal for a finance or accounting professional who demonstrates strong technical expertise, sound judgment, independence, and an interest in contributing to a mission\-driven nonprofit organization.

Key Responsibilities

**1\. Financial Reporting and Budget Management**

* Prepare accurate and timely financial reports for the Executive Director, Board of Directors, and relevant program leads.
* Monitor organizational revenue, expenditures, cash flow, and overall financial performance.
* Develop and maintain annual organizational budgets in collaboration with leadership.
* Prepare financial forecasts and identify potential financial risks, needs, and opportunities.
* Compile annual financial information and reports for funders, donors, auditors, and other stakeholders.
* Develop and maintain practical financial dashboards and reporting tools where appropriate.
* Provide financial analysis and recommendations to support organizational planning and decision\-making.

**2\. Bookkeeping and Financial Administration**

* Maintain accurate, complete, and organized financial records.
* Record and categorize financial transactions in accordance with established accounting procedures.
* Ensure invoices, receipts, reimbursements, and other financial documentation are properly maintained.
* Initiate, document, and organize payments for approved organizational and program expenses.
* Perform or oversee bank reconciliations and month\-end and year\-end financial processes.
* Maintain and troubleshoot integrations between accounting, banking, payroll, and other financial systems.
* Ensure financial records are properly organized and available for authorized review.

**3\. Banking and Cash Flow Management**

* Oversee organizational bank and investment accounts.
* Monitor account balances, cash flow, and upcoming financial obligations.
* Ensure organizational funds are managed in accordance with approved budgets, internal policies, and funding restrictions.
* Maintain appropriate financial controls and authorization procedures.
* Identify opportunities to improve financial efficiency while maintaining accountability and transparency.
* Support responsible cash management and financial planning.

**4\. Payroll, Tax Filing, and Regulatory Compliance**

* Process payroll and employee expense reimbursements accurately and on time.
* Prepare and issue required employee tax documentation.
* Coordinate annual Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) filings and other applicable nonprofit or charitable reporting requirements.
* Maintain documentation required for financial audits, regulatory filings, and organizational reviews.
* Support compliance with applicable payroll, taxation, funding, and financial reporting requirements.
* Coordinate with external accountants, auditors, and other financial professionals when required.
* Ensure appropriate confidentiality and security of financial and employee information.

**5\. Financial Systems and Process Improvement**

* Review existing financial procedures and identify opportunities for improvement.
* Develop and maintain efficient, transparent, and practical financial management systems.
* Establish clear procedures for expense tracking, reimbursements, payment approvals, budgeting, and reporting.
* Improve financial documentation and recordkeeping practices.
* Support the integration and effective use of accounting and financial management software.
* Develop scalable financial processes that support RCHC's operational needs and continued growth.

**6\. Financial Leadership and Organizational Collaboration**

* Provide financial guidance and recommendations to the Executive Director and Board of Directors.
* Communicate financial information clearly to individuals without an accounting or finance background.
* Collaborate with program staff to support budget monitoring and responsible expenditure management.
* Contribute financial insight to organizational planning and strategic discussions.
* Support financial accountability across programs and operational activities.
* Promote a culture of transparency, accuracy, and responsible financial stewardship.

Qualifications and Experience

**Required Qualifications**

* Demonstrated professional experience in accounting, bookkeeping, financial management, or nonprofit financial administration.
* Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks or comparable accounting software.
* Experience preparing financial reports, budgets, reconciliations, and financial records.
* Familiarity with payroll processing, CRA

jobs.title: Director, Central Funding & Equities Financial Control
jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**What is the opportunity?**


The Director, Central Funding \& Equities Financial Control is a key leader in the Wholesale Financial Control team, responsible for managing a team of accounting professionals to provide critical governance and control functions over the financial results of the Central Funding Group and Global Equities business lines within RBC Capital Markets. This includes analysis and advice on key business transactions and initiatives, as well as partnership with various cross\-functional stakeholders to deliver timely, accurate and reliable financial information.

 **What will you do?**

* Establishing the control and governance framework over the financial reporting for each business area as well as ensuring flawless execution of close processes, including review of financial and regulatory submissions
* Oversee the financial and regulatory reporting for all supported business lines to ensure the timely production of accurate financial and regulatory results and disclosures.
* Ensure that new products and new transactions are appropriately captured, and that appropriate accounting methodologies are applied.
* Prepare analyses that take into account IFRS accounting implications and external and internal reporting requirements including MD\&A, B/S, P\&L, note disclosures \& supplemental formats.
* Manage the monthly Global Attestation review program to ensure proper financial controls supporting external financial results are in place.
* Establish and maintain relationships with the business and other key stakeholders striving to be a trusted business partner and the first port of call in resolving finance\-related issues.
* Develop an understanding of the results of your businesses and key drivers for accounting variances, aiming to provide value\-added advice as the business transforms and adapts to accommodate changes in client needs and the economic environment.
* Empowering the team to innovate and develop initiatives to transform the efficiency and effectiveness of financial control processes, for example, through designing controls and governance procedures with an appropriate risk\-based lens; enhancing processes for better flows; automating manual processes or optimizing data strategies.
* Collaborate with others in the Wholesale Finance team to identify opportunities to understand flows on an end\-to\-end basis, leveraging the diverse expertise of different stakeholders to identify viable and actionable opportunities for improvement.
* Provide strategic business advice on the implementation of high priority new business initiatives as it relates to the Finance governance and reporting process, and collaborate with stakeholders to ensure successful execution of the business strategy.
* Actively manage and represent Finance function on platform/ global IT system projects/initiatives.
* Lead a small team, enabling high performance through active coaching and candid feedback, with an eye to longer term development of your team member’s skills and capabilities.

 **What do you need to succeed?**

**Must\-have**

* CPA designation or equivalent, with 8\+ years of relevant experience.
* Strong knowledge of relevant financial and regulatory accounting standards.
* People Management experience, with strong leadership and team building skills.
* Drive to take ownership of issues and ability to motivate and collaborate with individuals from different functional groups to drive resolution with a sense of urgency.
* Curiosity to explore improvements to the status quo and motivate the team to do the same.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, including comfort presenting to Senior Management and an ability to explain complex issues in a concise and clear manner.
* Some exposure to Capital Markets businesses including an understanding of complex financial instruments and transactions relating to securities, derivatives and debt/equity issuances, together with a willingness and interest in deepening that knowledge.

 **Nice to Have**

* Experience with financial IT systems and associated procedures

 **What’s in it for you?**


We thrive on the challenge to be our best, progressive thinking to keep growing, and working together to deliver trusted advice to help our clients thrive and communities prosper. We care about each other, reaching our potential, making a difference to our communities, and achieving success that is mutual.

* A comprehensive Total Rewards Program including bonuses and flexible benefits
* Leaders who support your development through coaching and managing opportunities
* Ability to make a difference and lasting impact
* Work in an agile, collaborative, progressive, and high\-performing team

jobs.title: AVP, Security Domain Enterprise Architecture
jobs.description:
You are as unique as your background, experience and point of view. Here, you’ll be encouraged, empowered and challenged to be your best self. You'll work with dynamic colleagues \- experts in their fields \- who are eager to share their knowledge with you. Your leaders will inspire and help you reach your potential and soar to new heights. Every day, you'll have new and exciting opportunities to make life brighter for our Clients \- who are at the heart of everything we do.  



  

At Sun Life, we're driven by our Purpose: helping our Clients achieve lifetime financial security and live healthier lives. Our values shape how we work: caring, authentic, bold, inspiring, and impactful.  



  

When you join Sun Life, you'll work with passionate colleagues and empowering leaders who support your growth and celebrate your contributions, so you can make a meaningful difference in our Clients' lives.  



  

Discover how you can make a difference in the lives of individuals, families and communities around the world.  



  

**Job Description:**

**About the role:**  

The AVP, Security Architecture is a senior leader accountable for the enterprise security architecture strategy, governance, and evolution of security capabilities across global business and technology environments.
  

The role translates business priorities, cyber risk appetite, and emerging threats into architecture direction that protects clients, employees, information, and critical services.  



  

Working closely with the CISO, CTO, enterprise architects, and business technology leaders, the AVP leads the Security Architecture function and embeds secure\-by\-design, Zero Trust, and defense\-in\-depth principles into enterprise transformation and solution delivery.  



  

The AVP serves as a senior security design authority within enterprise architecture governance, shapes security investment priorities, and develops a team that provides consistent architectural guidance across business units and geographies.  



  

  

**What You Will Do?**  

**Key Responsibilities:**  



**1\. Enterprise Security Architecture Strategy and Road mapping**
------------------------------------------------------------------

* Own the enterprise security architecture strategy and target state across identity, cloud, infrastructure, networks, endpoints, applications, data, and security platforms.
* Establish multi\-year security capability roadmaps aligned with business priorities, enterprise architecture, the cybersecurity strategy, and organizational risk appetite.
* Translate capability assessments, threat trends, and the NIST Cybersecurity Framework into prioritized architecture improvements, with Zero Trust and defense in depth guiding modernization.

**2\. Security Architecture Function and People Leadership**
------------------------------------------------------------

* Lead and develop the Security Architecture team, with accountability for performance, coaching, succession planning, and the skills required to support enterprise priorities.
* Define the function's operating model, engagement processes, and service expectations, providing architecture coverage across security programs and business\-led technology initiatives.
* Prioritize demand and allocate capacity across strategic planning, project assurance, governance, and emerging technology work; establish coverage and knowledge\-sharing practices that reduce dependence on individual specialists.
Manage the function's operating plan, assigned budget, and resources, and build business cases for additional capacity or specialist support.  
* 

  

**3\. Architecture Governance and Design Authority**
----------------------------------------------------

* Establish security reference architectures, standards, reusable patterns, and guardrails in partnership with global domain architects and enterprise security policy owners.
* Serve as senior security design authority for significant initiatives within the enterprise architecture governance process, with clear decision rights and escalation paths.
* Represent Security Architecture on enterprise technology review boards, resolve cross\-domain design issues, and oversee design assurance against approved security requirements.
* Oversee recommendations for architectural exceptions, compensating controls, and remediation plans; escalate material residual risks to accountable business and risk owners through established governance.

**4\. Secure Solution Design and Transformation Oversight**
-----------------------------------------------------------

* Provide security architecture oversight for major business and technology initiatives from early planning through implementation, with review effort proportionate to risk and complexity.
* Embed threat modelling, secure design reviews, and reusable security patterns into delivery practices, partnering with application, data, infrastructure, cloud, and engineering teams.
Lead architectural direction for security transformation programs, including identity modernization, cloud security, network segmentation, application security, data protection, and cyber recovery.  
* 

  

**5\. Security Capability Portfolio and Investment Leadership**
---------------------------------------------------------------

* Direct the strategic evolution, integration, consolidation, and retirement of security tools, services, and capabilities to address enterprise needs and reduce fragmentation.
* Shape investment priorities and present business cases that assess risk reduction, control coverage, technical feasibility, interoperability, operational capacity, and total cost of ownership.
* Maintain an enterprise view of capability gaps, overlapping technologies, lifecycle risks, and technical debt; partner with engineering, operations, procurement, and vendor management to turn roadmaps into achievable investment and delivery plans.

**6\. Technology Evaluation and AI Security**
------------------
